fit.mechanism: Algebraic legacy-to-proposed control lift, then one projected-gradient trajectory per head. Optimize measured terminal regret; nonlinear backtracking preserves all 134 older head argmax decisions and protected score margins. No lookup table, teacher or constraints execute at inference.
fit.limitations: Combined TRAIN regret improves 42.3%, but attack-only argmax regret slightly worsens. Expected loss and actual selected-action regret are different metrics. Move/control stopped early at the stronger exact-choice constraints; convergence or optimality is not claimed.
